__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="money-making" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Money-making </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Training buyable skills and upgrading your gear can be expensive, but there are money making methods that are effective even as a lower-level player. These are just a few methods you can try out - there are a lot more methods in the game for you to explore.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: It is assumed that you have no main account / high-level alt. If you can or want to transfer GP from another account (or purchase bonds </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213538463121408.png?v=1" alt="Bond" title="Bond" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), then skip this section.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="passive-methods"><ins><nowiki>Passive Methods</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These methods don't take much time and can give enough money to generate some consistent daily revenue, but are limited in how frequently they can be done. Some of these methods or locations may require quests - </nowiki><em><nowiki>you do not have to go out of your way to level your skills, these are simply some of the possible options you have.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Combined, these methods are enough to generate a few million GP/day </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for little time investment.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shop-runs"><nowiki>Shop Runs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Involves buying out shop stock to sell on the GE to other players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Check the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Mega_shop_run <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki> for all shop locations.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Starting money </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="player-owned-ports-requires-one-lvl-90-of"><nowiki>Player-owned ports (requires one lvl 90 of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864807920250900.png?v=1" alt="thieving" title="thieving" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864816073969734.png?v=1" alt="runecrafting" title="runecrafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1" alt="hunter" title="hunter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1" alt="divination" title="divination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705729192820747.png?v=1" alt="cooking" title="cooking" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864812458491924.png?v=1" alt="construction" title="construction" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1" alt="agility" title="agility" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1" alt="fishing" title="fishing" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Very long-term investment, not immediate profit</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Profit comes once you have reached near the end of player-owned ports and can focus on sending your ships for trade goods like bones </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863294741196820.png?v=1" alt="portsancientbones" title="portsancientbones" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to make tradeable scrimshaws to sell.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ See the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Player-owned_port/Strategies <nowiki>Player Owned Ports Guide</nowiki>]<nowiki> or ask in Discord if you need help with progressing ports.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="using-invention-machines-requires-72"><nowiki>Using Invention Machines (requires 72 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Auto Alchemiser machines can be used to automatically high-alch items over time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Alchemiser_machine <nowiki>Alchemiser mk. II</nowiki>]<nowiki> (108 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) is more profitable since it doesn't require fire runes, and processes more items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use the Wiki </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/RuneScape:Grand_Exchange_Market_Watch/Alchemiser <nowiki>calculator</nowiki>]<nowiki> to help identify items that can be bought on the GE and alched profitably.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is passive income over time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="skilling-methods"><ins><nowiki>Skilling Methods</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Non-PvM ways to make money. Note that some of these methods (e.g. crafting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1" alt="Bloodrune" title="Bloodrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) may require high skilling levels, so you can just choose methods that you have the levels for instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="runecrafting"><nowiki>Runecrafting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864816073969734.png?v=1" alt="runecrafting" title="runecrafting" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Runecrafting_training <nowiki>Runecrafting</nowiki>]<nowiki> high-demand runes can be quite profitable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Crafting_blood_runes_through_the_Abyss <nowiki>Blood</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1" alt="Bloodrune" title="Bloodrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (77 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864816073969734.png?v=1" alt="runecrafting" title="runecrafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_of_Seergaze/Quick_guide <nowiki>legacy of Seergaze</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest) and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Crafting_necrotic_runes#Spirit_runes <nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138808705362710680.png?v=1" alt="spiritrune" title="spiritrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138808701029982319.png?v=1" alt="bonerune" title="bonerune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138808695703207967.png?v=1" alt="fleshrune" title="fleshrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138808692087730206.png?v=1" alt="miasmarune" title="miasmarune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> runes (20+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864816073969734.png?v=1" alt="runecrafting" title="runecrafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mythos/Quick_guide <nowiki>Rune Mythos</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest) are typically the most profitable runes to craft.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended to have as many boosts as possible while doing this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="croesus-recommended-80-in-or"><nowiki>Croesus </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1037461776356348035.png?v=1" alt="croesus" title="croesus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (recommended 80+ in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248186782699541.png?v=1" alt="woodcutting" title="woodcutting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1" alt="mining" title="mining" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1" alt="hunter" title="hunter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1" alt="fishing" title="fishing" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The skilling boss </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Croesus <nowiki>Croesus</nowiki>]<nowiki> can be </nowiki><em><nowiki>very</nowiki></em><nowiki> good GP/hr.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Has both good common drops as well as expensive rare drops </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Defeating_Croesus <nowiki>(link)</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can use W68 public lobbies or teamforming servers/clans/etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="big-game-hunter-75-55"><nowiki>Big Game Hunter (75+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1" alt="hunter" title="hunter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 55+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For example, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Game_Hunter <nowiki>hunting</nowiki>]<nowiki> tier 1 dinosaurs for dragon mattock, or tier 2 dinosaurs to sell their meats to players doing tier 3 dinosaurs can be good profit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This requires some practice to do efficiently (</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Game_Hunter/Strategies <nowiki>link for strategies</nowiki>]<nowiki>), but is a nice way to train the skill profitably.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use of movement skills </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the mobile perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is strongly recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="miscellaneous-methods"><ins><nowiki>Miscellaneous methods</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>The further down the list, the higher the requirements generally become.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="collecting-zamorak-mjolnirs"><nowiki>Collecting Zamorak Mjolnirs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak mjolnirs can be collected and sold for profit, with few requirements.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ See the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Money_making_guide/Finding_Zamorak_mjolnirs <nowiki>Wiki guide</nowiki>]<nowiki> for more information.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="easy-clues"><nowiki>Easy Clues </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586950989885510.png?v=1" alt="easyclue" title="easyclue" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Clue_scroll_(easy) <nowiki>Easy clue scrolls</nowiki>]<nowiki> are part of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Treasure_Trails <nowiki>Treasure Trails</nowiki>]<nowiki>, in which a player follows a series of clues leading towards a buried treasure. They're a great way to make money early on, averaging around 700k coins </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per clue. Easy clue scrolls are between 3 to 5 clue steps long.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gathering</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can gather them from either low-level monsters or pickpocketing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/H.A.M._Hideout <nowiki>H.A.M. members</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 15 Thieving </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864807920250900.png?v=1" alt="thieving" title="thieving" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Levelling up Thieving </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864807920250900.png?v=1" alt="thieving" title="thieving" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Agility </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1" alt="agility" title="agility" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to 50 significantly decreases your chance at failing a pickpocketing action.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solving</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Easy clue steps (unlike the higher tiers) can always be completed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Most of the profit from Easy Reward Caskets comes from unique items. that disassemble into </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Category:Items_that_disassemble_into_Fortunate_components <nowiki>Fortunate</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435543845797891.png?v=1" alt="fortunatecomp" title="fortunatecomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> components.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Sell the items on the GE directly, usually for 1-1.5m </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per item.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Clue recommendations</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Emote clues are a type of clue scroll where players perform an emote with specific items equipped. These items can be kept in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Hidey-holes <nowiki>hidey-holes</nowiki>]<nowiki> (27 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864812458491924.png?v=1" alt="construction" title="construction" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), which are storage boxes found at each clue location where they're needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Completing clue scrolls means travelling across Gielinor, which is why access to certain teleports can speed up this process a lot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The following </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=DcerXrWgcHb2RLhlzlb1 <nowiki>preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/a918bbc6db418ce9ebef3c3b7369bf7bc2504ab71994980bb8da7598d144166d.webp" alt="easy clue preset" kind="addition" /><nowiki> from the </nowiki>[https://discord.com/invite/cluechasers <nowiki>Clue Chasers discord</nowiki>]<nowiki> is advised if you do decide on solving easy clues frequently.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runeapps.org/ <nowiki>Alt1</nowiki>]<nowiki> is a Jagex-allowed third-party application that consists of several quality of life overlays on your screen.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ One of these plug-ins is called the Clue Solver, it checks the clue you have open on your screen and tells you how to solve it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="binding-contracts"><nowiki>Binding Contracts </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883118521557052.png?v=1" alt="bindingcontract" title="bindingcontract" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Making </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_contract <nowiki>binding contracts</nowiki>]<nowiki> to then turn into Ancient familiar pouches for profit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Varied selection of Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> monsters makes it a versatile method.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Having a way to quickly note or bank the pouches is highly recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Requires the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dagon_Bye <nowiki>Dagon Bye</nowiki>]<nowiki> mystery.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
</div>
</div>
